column1: # IKMA Manager's sentences. English [TAB] translation. Keep the {0} {1} blanks; keep the letter Y.
Looking for Inscryption in your Steam library.
Inscryption was not found in your Steam library.
Type or paste the full path of your Inscryption folder, then press Enter. Or just press Enter to quit.
That folder does not contain Inscryption.exe.
IKMA version {0} is installed and turned on.
IKMA is installed and turned on.
IKMA version {0} is installed but turned off. Inscryption starts without it.
IKMA is installed but turned off. Inscryption starts without it.
IKMA is not installed in this game folder.
Main menu. Press Enter alone to install or update IKMA. Or type a number, then press Enter. 1, install or update. 2, settings. 3, turn IKMA back on. 4, uninstall. 5, quit.
Main menu. Press Enter alone to install or update IKMA. Or type a number, then press Enter. 1, install or update. 2, settings. 3, turn IKMA off. 4, uninstall. 5, quit.
That is not one of the choices.
IKMA is not installed, so there is nothing to turn off.
IKMA is turned off. Inscryption starts without it. BepInEx and your other mods are unchanged, and IKMA's settings are kept.
IKMA is turned back on. It starts with the game.
IKMA was turned off. Installing turned it back on.
Settings. Type a number, then press Enter to change it. Press Enter alone to go back to the main menu. Changes take effect the next time you start the game.
{0}. Type a number, then press Enter. Press Enter alone to keep it as it is.
Inscryption is running. Close the game, then press Enter.
This Inscryption is not the 32-bit version this installer was made for. Nothing was changed.
BepInEx is already installed. Kept as it is.
Installed IKMA and its speech files.
Done. Start Inscryption from Steam as usual. IKMA will speak at the title screen.
IKMA is uninstalled. BepInEx was left in place, because other mods may use it.
IKMA was not installed in this folder.
Windows would not let the installer write to the game folder. Close this window, right-click IKMA_Manager and choose Run as administrator.
This installer is incomplete: a file it carries is missing. Download it again.
Something went wrong, and the install stopped: {0}
BepInEx {0} is already installed for your other mods. Kept exactly as it is.
This game has BepInEx 6 installed. IKMA needs BepInEx 5, and replacing it would break your other mods. Nothing was changed.
This game has another mod loader installed ({0}). Adding BepInEx beside it could break your other mods. Nothing was changed.
The BepInEx in this game folder is the 64-bit build, which cannot load in this 32-bit game. Nothing was changed; it needs the 32-bit BepInEx.
BepInEx is here, but the file that starts it with the game (winhttp.dll) is missing. Type Y and press Enter to add it. Press Enter alone to leave everything as it is.
Added the file that starts BepInEx.
Left BepInEx as it is. IKMA is installed but will not load until BepInEx starts with the game.
Note: BepInEx is switched off in doorstop_config.ini (enabled=false). IKMA will not load until it is switched on. The installer did not change it.
Found an earlier IKMA at {0}. Updated it there.
More than one copy of IKMA is installed: {0}. Remove all but one, then run this again. Nothing was changed.
{0} from another mod was saved as {1}.before-IKMA. Uninstalling IKMA puts it back.

Note: a mod manager (r2modman or Thunderstore) is set up for Inscryption on this PC. If you start the game from the mod manager, add IKMA to that profile too; this installer set up the game started from Steam.
Automatic: new versions download and install with no question.
Off: IKMA never connects to the internet.
Automatic: your screen reader on Windows, the IKMA speech helper on a Steam Deck.
Always your screen reader, through UniversalSpeech: NVDA, JAWS, or Windows speech.
Always the IKMA speech helper, for Steam Deck and Linux.
Off: the short log, what IKMA said and anything that went wrong.
On: every diagnostic line, for a bug report. The log gets much longer.
Repeat, describe, or advance a conversation
Next playable card, slot, or sacrifice
Rulebook for the last heard abilities
Game info: scales, bones, and teeth
Rulebook for the last heard abilities, second button
every action on its default button

Controller buttons. Type a number, then press Enter to move that action to another button. Type R, then press Enter, to put every action back on its default button. Press Enter alone to go back to settings.
Every action is back on its default button.
{0}, now on {1}. Which shoulder buttons are held with it? Type a number, then press Enter. 1, none. 2, LB. 3, RB. 4, LB and RB together. Press Enter alone to keep it as it is.
Which button for {0}? Type a number, then press Enter. Press Enter alone to keep it as it is.
Swapped. {0} is now on {1}, and {2} is now on {3}.
Exact: IKMA asks NVDA when each line has finished. Needs NVDA 2024.1 or later.
Estimated: IKMA guesses how long each line takes to read.
On: every spoken line is also sent to your braille display, through NVDA or JAWS.
Off: nothing is sent to a braille display.
